mentions.name: FoldRoute
mentions.description: A progressive web app (PWA) route planner for folding bikes that combines cycling legs with public transport connections. Currently German-only, with navigation still needing real-world testing; a native Android/iOS app may come later.
mentions.problem: There was no good planner for combining biking with public transport, a gap the author noticed after buying a Brompton folding bike.
mentions.source_excerpt: FoldRoute - a PWA route planer for folding bikes & public transport
mentions.author: Lars147
